verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents a public REST API: a curl example creates sessions at api.stripe.com/v1/identity/verification_sessions, and the Verification Sessions API tracks each verification from creation to results. Results are retrievable programmatically with a secret key, webhook events fire on every status change, and documents can be blocklisted programmatically. Docs are also served as agent-readable markdown and llms.txt. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
